title: containerCOMP Class
summary: Official Derivative Python API reference for Container COMP instances, covering click() at a panel location, clickChild() for sub-panels, group labels, and inherited PanelCOMP / COMP behavior.
guidance: Use this article when a script needs to simulate a click at a specific location inside a Container COMP panel.
Use click(u, v) to update the container's U and V interaction coordinates at a specific location.
Use clickChild(childIndex) to click a sub-panel by index, including radio buttons inside a single container.
Use group when the simulated click needs an optional panel group label compatible with Button COMP group behavior.
Use force carefully because it can click even when the container or child panel is disabled; specify left, middle, or right when the default left-button event is not the target.
